text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
<username> Trainer, —would you like to become a 
horse girl?!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that was a bit too abrupt, wasn't 
it...! I meant strictly within a game!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
A new program has been added to the 
full-dive VR special device over there, 
the "VR Umalator"—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
And amazingly, it seems you can use a 
horse girl avatar to "experience a horse 
girl's power firsthand"!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Count me in too♪ When it comes to games, 
I'm not gonna lose!

A horse girl who popped up out of 
nowhere... Tokai Teio stepped in front of 
the VR Umalator and swiftly operated the 
controls.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You'd wanna test it against a real horse 
girl mixed in, right~? Let's see, the only 
mode available right now is tag—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yup, all set! You're playing as the 
Kaicho!

The Kaicho, also known as the "Emperor" 
Symboli Rudolf, is widely known as one of 
the strongest among all horse girls.

Even if it's just a VR game, experiencing 
that power firsthand would undoubtedly 
serve as great reference for the 
future...!

text_block_list.name: Meek (Kiryuin)
text_block_list.text:
!! <username> Trainer, you look just like the real 
Symboli Rudolf-san!

text_block_list.name: Meek (Kiryuin)
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, what astonishing fidelity...! 
My body properly turned into Meek's as 
well...!
choice_data_list:
Why did you choose that avatar, Trainer 
Kiryuin?

text_block_list.name: Meek (Kiryuin)
text_block_list.text:
...Actually, I've felt lately that her 
training workload might be too demanding. 
I wanted to experience her abilities 
firsthand to review her regimen—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you two~ The game has already—... 
started!!

text_block_list.name: Speaker
text_block_list.text:
"You are 'It'. You have been tagged by 
Tokai Teio-san."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aww, spacing out like that. That's not 
very Kaicho-like at all♪
choice_data_list: Then... I'll just have to tag you back!
Then... I'll just tag you right back!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whoops! Too slow, too slow!

text_block_list.name: Meek (Kiryuin)
text_block_list.text: Tr-Trainer-san! Let's chase after her!

Though relying on imitation, I steady my 
breathing and put power into the soles of 
my feet. Locking my gaze on the distant 
Tokai Teio—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaaaa?! So fa—...st!

text_block_list.name: Speaker
text_block_list.text:
"Tokai Teio-san has been tagged. Tokai 
Teio-san is now 'It'."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wh-What the...! That was—
choice_data_list: So this is Symboli Rudolf's leg power...!

text_block_list.name: Speaker
text_block_list.text:
"Tokai Teio-san is 'It'. Failure to tag 
within 5 minutes results in defeat."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehhhh~~! No way, no way! There's no waaaay 
I'm losingーー!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... I'm not letting my guard down 
anymore! I'm going all out, got it?!

And so, returning to our childlike 
spirits, the all-out game of tag continued 
until the time limit ran out.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I b-barely... won...!
choice_data_list:
If only I could've used Rudolf's legs more 
effectively...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Meek's legs were incredibly powerful 
as well... It was a fantastic experience 
to understand her capabilities!
choice_data_list:
Is that so! Then I should also try my 
trainee's—

Is that so! Then I should try my trainee's 
as well—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Wanna try fighting me one more time as 
<chrname>?
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, I'm not handing you the win.
...Yep, I won't let you have the win.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ahaha—now you're talking!
